source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary: Whenever an attack with the barbed ovipositor of this model destroys an **INFANTRY** model, once this model has finished all its attacks you can put a new **RIPPER SWARMS** unit of D3 models into your army, placed up to 3" from this model. It can be placed in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of the unit that lost the destroyed model, but of no other enemy unit.

detail.trigger: barbed ovipositor attack destroys an INFANTRY model
detail.timing: after this model has finished making its attacks
